Run.Description: least-contended allowed processor (0x1; Linux efficiency class unknown)
Run.InputContract: PythonRe over str: valid unchanged UTF8; public FindAllToStrings, two captures, 2048 tuples, every value checked after each64-call batch. CPU attribution only, not throughput/parity/speedup.

Cpu.Scope: ONE whole-process cpu-clock:u/997Hz CPU IP capture. Includes startup, warmup, public multi-capture FindAllToStrings batches, checksum, GC and runtime work. Flat self samples with JIT map addresses; inlined costs belong to their containing method. Not per-phase timings, a public speedup, causal optimization proof or an exact CPU percentage. Managed sampled-thread-time PollGC shares are not used as CPU attribution.
